candidates.buyer: Small unincorporated and incorporated NPOs (churches, village and sports groups, charities), and the accountants or volunteer treasurers who serve them
candidates.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
candidates.evidence: https://www.belizefsc.org.bz/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/Act-No-14-of-2023-Non-Profit-Organization.pdf ; https://www.belizefsc.org.bz/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/FSC_BCCAR-NPO-Webinar_23-04-2024.pdf (PDF would not parse, details taken from search summaries) ; https://www.nationalassembly.gov.bz/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/SI-No.-30-of-2025-Non-Profit-Organizations-Accounting-Requirements-For-Specified-Classes-Order-2025.pdf ; https://www.belizefsc.org.bz/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/SI-No-45-of-2024-Non-profit-Organisations-Extension-of-Period-Order-2024.pdf ; Bar Association says definition covers all churches and community organisations: https://amandala.com.bz/news/bar-association-questions-practical-need-for-npo-bill
candidates.existing: Competitor search (NGO/NPO compliance service, annual return, OBRS, church association) found only company-focused providers (Expanship compliance packages, BBCIncorp IBC notices) and the FSC's own free webinars; no NPO-specific product seen. The state OBRS portal handles filing itself.
candidates.name: NPO Act compliance pack for churches, associations and community groups (registration, annual return, accounts, record-keeping)
candidates.trigger: Non-Profit Organisations Act 2023 (Act 14/2023, in force 13 May 2023; amended Act 51/2023); annual return via OBRS within 4 months of financial year end (incorporated), email route for unincorporated; SI 30 of 2025 audit requirement at BZ$500,000 revenue; 2025 Record Keeping Threshold Order; unregistered or suspended NPOs cannot raise funds.
candidates.unchecked: Number of registered NPOs; exact fee schedule and deadlines; content of the 2025 record-keeping order; whether OBRS already gives reminders; willingness of volunteer-run bodies to pay.

candidates.buyer: Small tour operators and licensed guides (dive, cave, fishing, river, island tours)
candidates.category: 31. Tourism licensing (BTB tour operators, tour guides)
candidates.existing: No competitor search run (budget). No dedicated product seen in the search results.
candidates.name: BTB tour operator and tour guide licence renewal binder (31 Dec cycle, document vault, expiry tracker)
candidates.trigger: Tour operator licences expire every 31 Dec; renewal by email with police records per owner (6 months old), vessel/vehicle licences and insurance, guide list, safety checklist, emergency plan; guide licences need police record, medical certificate and CPR certificate; unrenewed operators are removed from the BTB list from 1 Jan. Penalty for operating unlicensed up to BZ$500 and/or 1 year (2018 notice).
candidates.unchecked: Competitor search; number of licensed operators and guides; current guide rules (2018 notice may be stale); whether BTB now has an online portal; document tracking is a thin product.

candidates.buyer: Fishers, tour boat and water-taxi owners, small marinas
candidates.category: 34. Port Authority vessel registration and licensing (boats, captains)
candidates.existing: BPA online portal with virtual inspection and proof-of-payment upload already exists, which covers most of the job.
candidates.name: Vessel re-licensing and inspection reminder for coastal boat owners (BPA registration, Master's licence, Seaworthiness Certificate)
candidates.trigger: All coastal and river vessels must be registered and licensed annually with the Belize Port Authority, with decals, Master's Licence, Seaworthiness Certificate; BZ$150 admin fee plus transport if an inspector must visit.
candidates.unchecked: Current fees and deadlines; fleet size; whether the online portal covers renewals fully.

candidates.buyer: Small bars, restaurants, shops holding Restaurant/Beer/Malt/Publican's/Shop licences
candidates.existing: None seen; no competitor search run.
candidates.name: Liquor licence renewal file preparation for small shops, bars and restaurants
candidates.trigger: Intoxicating Liquor Licensing Act Cap 150; district boards re-established each year by Order (SI 3 of 2025; SI 1 of 2026) and renew licences at an annual board meeting, applications rejected for incomplete documents.
candidates.unchecked: Required documents per licence type; fees; whether other district boards run the same annual cycle; competitor search; thin as a standalone product.

candidates.buyer: Fisher cooperatives (conch and lobster) and their members
candidates.name: Fisher cooperative quota and catch-record tool for conch/lobster
candidates.trigger: Fisheries Department queen conch national quota (about 950,000 lb) with early closures when met; pre- and post-season data collected with co-managers; some cooperatives did not fill quotas in 2023-24; lobster trap limits and closed seasons.
candidates.unchecked: Cooperative reporting forms and deadlines; number of cooperatives; whether Fisheries already runs an electronic catch system.

candidates.buyer: Small bus, shuttle, tour-transport and taxi operators
candidates.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
candidates.name: Road Service Permit and fleet-standards tracker for bus, busito and taxi operators
candidates.trigger: Road Service Permit per category (Highway, Shuttle, Village, Tour, Charter, Workers, School), duration tied to bus age (up to 10 years for newer, 2 for over 15); Transport Board can suspend or revoke; busitos and taxis flagged for the next modernisation phase after omnibuses; BZ$500 fine reported.
candidates.unchecked: Taxi-phase rules and dates; permit renewal procedure and fees; fleet sizes.

candidates.buyer: Individual short-term rental hosts and small guest houses
candidates.category: 29. Hotels, guest houses and short-term rentals: guest registers, tourism levies
candidates.existing: BTB tax portal already takes monthly returns (see K07 rejection); enforcement reported light by third-party sites (unverified).
candidates.name: Annual BTB registration and licence for small Airbnb and vacation-rental hosts
candidates.trigger: Hotels and Tourist Accommodation Act Cap 285 s.5: annual registration and licence before advertising; fine up to BZ$10,000 or 3 years; 9% tax remitted to BTB; tourist-visa guests must use BTB-registered providers.
candidates.unchecked: Registration process detail; number of hosts; whether enforcement has tightened in 2025-26.

candidates.name: Scrap metal recycler licence and export-permit register
candidates.trigger: Scrap Metal Recyclers Regulations (2011): 12-month licence from Dept of the Environment, export permit per shipment, authorised trucks for domestic transport.
candidates.unchecked: Whether regulations are still current or amended; number of licensees; register or record-keeping duties.

candidates.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
candidates.name: Veterinary drug and pesticide seller premises registration and permit tracker
candidates.trigger: Veterinary Drugs Regulations SI 184 of 2001 (premises registration Reg 12, import permits, product registration); Pesticides Control Board seller registration BZ$100 per year, restricted pesticides need authorisation.
candidates.unchecked: Number of sellers; recurring reporting duties; current rules after 2023.

candidates.buyer: Small licence and permit holders for timber
candidates.category: 30. Small exporters and importers facing traceability or certification rules: food, fish, timber, forest-risk commodities
candidates.name: Small logger and sawmiller movement documents (waybill, hammer stamp, Permission to Haul) after 2025 moratorium
candidates.trigger: Forest Rules: waybill, property brand, hammer stamp both ends, Permission to Haul per load; 5-year moratorium on new Short-Term Forest Licences and Petty Permits from 1 Dec 2025; season closed 15 Jul 2026.
candidates.unchecked: Number of active permit holders (likely small given moratorium); paper vs digital waybills.

candidates.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
candidates.existing: Not checked; household-specific rule not confirmed.
candidates.name: Domestic worker Social Security registration and contribution helper for household employers
candidates.trigger: Social Security (Registration of Employers and Employed Persons) Regulations: employer of anyone 14+ working 8+ hours per week must register and not hire an unregistered person; SI 24 of 2023 amended fees.
candidates.unchecked: Whether private households must register; compliance level; willingness to pay.

candidates.category: 23. Co-operatives, credit unions and savings groups
candidates.existing: Not checked; credit unions likely use core banking vendors.
candidates.name: Credit union returns to the Central Bank (quarterly balance sheet and P&L, CUA requirements)
candidates.trigger: Credit Unions Act (Revised 2011; Amendment Act 21 of 2023); CUA Requirements 1 and 2 on loan classification and allowances; regular returns to Central Bank.
candidates.unchecked: Number of credit unions (small); return forms; existing core systems.

candidates.category: 33. Gaming and lotteries (Gaming and Lotteries Control Act 2026)
candidates.name: Gaming and Lotteries Control Act 2026 licence compliance
candidates.trigger: Act No. 3 of 2026 (table of contents only read; status unconfirmed); older Gaming Control Act and Online Gaming Regulations.
candidates.unchecked: Whether in force; number of operators (one online licensee in 2022); small buyer pool.

candidates.category: 21. Fuel stations and fuel or LPG distributors
candidates.name: LPG distributor permit and price-schedule compliance
candidates.trigger: Supplies Control (Distribution of LPG) Regulations SI 80 of 2019, provisional permit per establishment; SI 156 of 2025 price schedule effective 20 Nov 2025; Environmental Clearance for depots.
candidates.unchecked: Number of distributors; recurring reports; fuel-station rules.

coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: SSB requires employers (any person employing someone 14+ for 8+ hours/week) to register and not hire unregistered persons; could not confirm any household-specific rule or product. Nothing new beyond K03; unverified.

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: Scrap Metal Recyclers Regulations (2011, Dept of Environment): 12-month licence, export permit per shipment, authorised trucks only. Small niche; currency unverified.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: No Belize pawn/second-hand statute surfaced in one search; unverified.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: Budget; no search run.

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: Budget; no search run.

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: Not searched beyond what K05 already covers.

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: BAHA Food Safety (SI 25 of 2001) inspects registered slaughterhouses; village by-laws SI 189 of 2004 require butcher licence; no current forms or digital process found. Weak.

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: Budget; no search run.

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: Veterinary Drugs Regulations SI 184 of 2001: product registration, premises registration (Reg 12), importer and manufacturer licences, via BAHA Veterinary Drugs Control Unit. Tiny buyer pool; weak.

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: Budget.

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: Budget.

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: Budget.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: Budget.

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: Pesticides Control Board: sellers apply on Form 1, BZ$100 per year for sale of registered pesticides; restricted-pesticide sale needs authorisation. Small pool; weak.

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: Budget; only the generic work-permit search touched this (see 26).

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: Budget.

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: Non-Profit Organisations Act 2023 (Act 14 of 2023, in force 13 May 2023) captures churches and community bodies; FSC Director General is Registrar; incorporated NPOs file annual return via OBRS within 4 months of financial year end, unincorporated ones by email; unregistered or suspended NPOs cannot solicit funds; SI 30 of 2025 requires audit for revenue of BZ$500,000 and up; a record-keeping threshold order was also issued in 2025. See candidate.

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: Road Service Permits from the Department of Transport/Transport Board; permit duration tied to bus age; fleet-upgrade deadline 31 Dec 2023, taxis and busitos were next in the modernisation phases (no follow-up found). See candidate.

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: Budget.

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Budget; BAHA food safety partly touched under 7.

coverage.category: 21. Fuel stations and fuel or LPG distributors
coverage.found: LPG distributors need a Supplies Control permit under SI 80 of 2019 (via Bureau of Standards); LPG depots need Environmental Clearance; retail/wholesale LPG prices set by SI 156 of 2025 (gazetted 20 Dec 2025). No fuel-station licensing rule found. Weak.

coverage.category: 22. Grain, coffee, cocoa and other commodity traders, millers and warehouses
coverage.found: Budget; sugar-cane covered by K04.

coverage.category: 23. Co-operatives, credit unions and savings groups
coverage.found: Credit unions regulated by the Central Bank under the Credit Unions Act (Revised 2011; Amendment Act 21 of 2023); regular balance-sheet and P&L returns to the Bank; quarterly data published. Co-operatives under Cap 313. No 2025 reporting change found. Weak.

coverage.category: 24. Private clinics, labs and other health providers that bill insurers or state schemes
coverage.found: NHI approved-provider list (clinics, pharmacies, labs, imaging) kept by the Social Security Board; billing and claims details not found. Unverified.

coverage.category: 25. Pharmacies, medicine importers, and users of controlled chemicals or precursors
coverage.found: Search found no Pharmacy Council or licensing process; only NHI pharmacy participation. Unverified.

coverage.category: 26. Security, cleaning and manpower agencies, and the firms that hire their workers
coverage.found: Only the foreign-worker Temporary Employment Permit (Labour Dept; employer applies and reports changes; roughly annual renewal; fees unconfirmed) surfaced. Unverified; nothing agency-specific.

coverage.category: 27. Construction, mining and quarry contractors and suppliers: site registers, accreditation, local-content reports
coverage.found: Budget.

coverage.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals with periodic or anti-money-laundering reports
coverage.found: Real estate agents are DNFBPs supervised by the FIU; no standalone broker licensing act found. Nothing new beyond K08.

coverage.category: 29. Hotels, guest houses and short-term rentals: guest registers, tourism levies
coverage.found: Hotels and Tourist Accommodation Act (Cap 285 s.5): annual registration and licence before advertising, fine up to BZ$10,000 or 3 years; 9% tax. Hotel-tax filing is K07 (rejected). See candidate for small Airbnb hosts.

coverage.category: 30. Small exporters and importers facing traceability or certification rules: food, fish, timber, forest-risk commodities
coverage.found: Forest Rules: waybill, property brand and hammer stamp, Permission to Haul per load; 5-year moratorium on new Short-Term Forest Licences and Petty Permits on national lands from 1 Dec 2025; logging season closed 15 Jul 2026. Conch quota/closure rules in 36. Weak.

coverage.category: 31. Tourism licensing (BTB tour operators, tour guides)
coverage.found: BTB tour operator licences expire every 31 Dec; applications by email, payment by bank; document-heavy renewal (police records per owner within 6 months, vessel/vehicle licences and insurance, guide list, safety checklist, emergency plan, fee BZ$250); operators not renewed by 1 Jan drop off the BTB website. Guide renewal needs police record, medical, CPR certificate (2018 notice, possibly stale). See candidate.

coverage.category: 32. Intoxicating liquor licensing (district boards)
coverage.found: Annual licensing boards re-formed each year by Order (SI 3 of 2025, SI 1 of 2026); licences renewed at one annual board meeting (e.g. San Pedro in January); incomplete documentation causes rejection. See candidate.

coverage.category: 33. Gaming and lotteries (Gaming and Lotteries Control Act 2026)
coverage.found: Act No. 3 of 2026 on the National Assembly site (table of contents only read); older Gaming Control Act and Online Gaming Regulations; very few licensed operators. Unverified and small.

coverage.category: 34. Port Authority vessel registration and licensing (boats, captains)
coverage.found: All coastal and river vessels (including skiffs, jet skis) must be registered and licensed annually with the BPA, plus Master's licence and Seaworthiness Certificate; online relicensing with virtual inspection and proof-of-payment upload exists; mobile clinics in coastal towns; BZ$150 admin fee for an inspector visit. See candidate.

coverage.category: 35. Fisheries: conch/lobster quotas, fisher cooperatives
coverage.found: Queen conch quota (about 950,000 lb) with closures when quota is met; 2025-26 season closed early, reopening expected 1 Oct 2026; some fisher cooperatives did not fill quotas in 2023-24. Cooperative reporting forms not found. See candidate.

coverage.category: 36. Other 2024-2026 instruments (SI 2025 index, Civil Registry and Vital Statistics Act 2025, Digital Asset Services licensing SI 162/2025)
coverage.found: Scanned 2025 SI list. Digital Asset Services licensing and the Civil Registry Act fees are not small-business recurring duties. Nothing else useful.
